text: Leni used the crutches. Felix said, “I want a stamp.” Leni said, “I need a level path.” Nia borrowed the brass compass. Nia chose the Fern Loop. Nia said, “I can wait.” The fallen birch blocked the path. Using the brass compass, Nia oriented the trail map. Felix lifted ivy. Leni noticed the blue marker. Nia and Felix and Leni followed the level detour. Leni drew the spotted salamander in the sketchbook. Ranger Ivo stamped the discovery card. Nia gave Ranger Ivo the brass compass. Leni showed Ranger Ivo the sketchbook. Felix held the discovery card.
